findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement without cause, and you will not be paid for services in progress upon termination.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
findings.explanation: Ownership of all deliverables passes to the client upon payment of only the first milestone, rather than upon full payment for the work.
findings.suggested_change: Upon payment in full of all applicable fees for the Deliverables, the Client owns all rights in such Deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped overall, but your indemnification obligations are excluded from the cap and have no limit.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, including any indemnification obligations.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a few adjustments before signing:
- Regarding the relevant clause, only the client can terminate the agreement without cause and fees for services in progress are not payable, and we propose that either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.
- In the relevant clause concerning deliverables, ownership passes upon payment of only the first milestone rather than full payment, and we propose that upon payment in full of all applicable fees for the Deliverables, the Client owns all rights in such Deliverables.
- Regarding the liability clause, liability is capped overall but indemnification obligations are excluded and have no limit, and we propose that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, including any indemnification obligations.
Best regards,
